name: ipad
title: iPad
description: A tablet drawn in SVG: a pale rounded shell around a black bezel and a clipped screen that holds any image. Pass a picture and it sits inside the device, scaled to the width and height you give it.
use: A wide screenshot or photo needs device context in a hero or feature block.
avoid: The screen crops with slice, so tall or narrow images lose their edges inside the frame.
a11y: The SVG carries no role, title or aria-label, so screen readers get an unlabelled graphic. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A landscape tablet on a black stage: a light grey rounded shell encloses a deep black border, and inside that a bright mountain photo. Corners are softly rounded, and two tiny camera dots sit in the top bezel.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds. It draws the image passed to it inside the screen area, cropped to fill, and resizes with the width and height props.
customise: The image source, width and height are props; the shell colour, bezel and camera dots are fixed in the SVG.
weight: light: One inline SVG with four shapes and a single image, with no script.
